title: Three Rotated Anisotropic Ellipses (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `vector_anisotropic` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Three equal-mass 2D Gaussians stretched along horizontal, vertical, and diagonal axes. Tests full 2x2 covariance fidelity so that matching a wide principal axis cannot hide collapse along the narrow axis.
failure_mode: Scalar-trace isotropic covariance trackers or misallocated prototype mass distort ellipse eccentricity and violate component_covariance_error or mass_tv.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `vector_anisotropic` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
